svg.title: Copy lead grows while attention remains nearly flat through the plateau.
svg.desc: Eight seeds aligned by plateau progress, (update - P) / (T - P), from -0.15 to 1. The shaded interval runs from plateau start to takeoff. Above, warm lines show attention to the correct value as a log ratio; zero means no preference. Below, teal lines show the answer's lead in logits with attention forced onto the correct value; dashed grey lines show the unforced lead. Only recorded points within the window are connected. The lower axis starts at zero, clipping small negative leads.
